lines.text: Here's the boot. Petrol and diesel versions are listed at 382 litres, measured to ISO V215.
For a stroller or weekend bags, bring your own and check the fit with the seats in use.

deeper.text: The CNG boot is listed at 321 litres using the same ISO V215 measurement basis. Capacity alone won't settle the fit of your luggage.
Creative Plus P S and Fearless Plus P S petrol and diesel trims have sixty-forty flip-and-fold rear seats, plus a rear armrest with a cup holder.

bank_answers.question: Does the Nexon come with six airbags and ISOFIX mounts as standard equipment across all variants?
bank_answers.answer: Yes, six airbags and ISOFIX child seat mounts are both standard equipment across the Nexon lineup. You also get three-point seatbelts for every passenger and an electronic stability program included as standard.

bank_answers.question: Does this Fearless + PS trim include both front-seat ventilation and rear AC vents?
bank_answers.answer: Yes. The documented Fearless + PS petrol and diesel versions include ventilated driver and co-driver seats, along with rear AC vents.
